Name: Razolyn the Magnificent - Now Marriageable- Wizard Replacement
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
[center]
﻿[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/mCRzEQq.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/center][font=Trebuchet MS]Razolyn the Magnificent is [u]THE[/u] Wizard Replacement Mod you are looking for!  Thanks to the efforts of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/26612284]ParadigmNomad[/url], Razolyn now has seven different  portraits: normal, happy, sad, angry, blushing, ditsy, and arrogant; versus the wizards' two: normal and happy.  Not only is she pleasing to look at, but each of her events has extended dialogue to give Razolyn her own unique personality and double the dialogue as you befriend her. 
Razolyn is now a Bachelorette!! There is NO OTHER MOD needed than what is listed in Installation.

[center][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/QpHx68J.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/center]
1. Ensure you have the latest and correct [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (2.7 or later)
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 1.5 or later
3. Download this mod and Unzip into your /Mods folder (should say [CP]RazolynStandalone)
4. Enjoy!

Spouse Room Available!!!
We now have a spouse room for Razolyn!!  Simply install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMX Loader[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿ then install the Spouse room!!
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238]foggywizard[/url]﻿!!!


[b]3.0 is in development!
[/b] ﻿No longer will Razolyn be a wizard replacement.  She will strike out on her own with her own house!  Be ready for a new Razolyn!

[list]

[*]Improvements to dialogue and schedule
[*]Added support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3312]Miss Coriel's NPC Unique Courtship Response[/url]﻿
[/list][size=4][b]IMPORTANT!!:  Razolyn 2.0 requires removal of the old [CP]RazolynStandalone folder.  Remember to delete the old version!!!

[/b][/size][size=5]Visit my [/size][url=https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf]Cozy Apartment[/url][size=5] if you have questions or interests.[/size]
